title: Advanced Context Engineering for Agents
summary: A talk on getting coding agents to work in large, existing codebases by keeping their context small and correct: split work into research, plan and implement, compact each step into a Markdown file, keep context use around 40–60%, and spend human review on the research and plan rather than every line of code. Summarised here from the written version in HumanLayer’s GitHub repository, which also notes where the approach failed; HumanLayer builds tools for this workflow.
